stem_book: A particle of mass m is suspended by means of an ideal string from 'O'; it is given horizontal velocity 'u' at lowest point to complete circular path in vertical plane. If m = 2 kg and g = 10 m s^(-2), difference in tension in the string when 'm' is at A and C is ____ N. (Figure: circle centre O, A the lowest point where u is given, C the highest point.)
